verdict.rationale: Buzz's own agent runtime, buzz-agent, is documented as an MCP client by design: it loops LLM calls and runs the resulting tool calls via MCP. It ships paired with an MCP server (buzz-dev-mcp) that gives agents a shell and file editor, and Persona Packs explicitly carry an MCP server config section for deployed personas. missing for 10: step-by-step docs on registering arbitrary third-party MCP servers (transport and config format), clarity on whether ACP-harnessed agents like goose/codex/claude get pack MCP config, independent or hands-on corroboration.
